response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship skills, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js, D-lang, and web/mobile stacks rather than Java/Kotlin/JVM tooling. Java appears only briefly (robotic arms, mobile orchestration tooling) and there is no evidence of Kotlin, Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate expertise, or IDE internals work, making him a poor match for this JVM-focused enterprise IDE role.
strengths: Deep, versatile engineering background across web, mobile, embedded, and systems domains
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development)
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex platforms and open-source tools end-to-end
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin experience and only minimal, dated Java exposure
No evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM framework experience
No background in IDE internals, language tooling, or build/application server integration

key_factors.factor: Lack of Kotlin/Spring/JVM enterprise framework experience
No IDE internals or language tooling experience
Strong general software engineering craftsmanship and complex systems experience
